subject: DocV
text:
Hi [NAME] - happy Friday!

Been working with Veriff and Onfido, and [COMPANY] came up given your
position in the IDV.

A common theme we're seeing: once models are live, challenges shift to
diagnosing failure modes and tightening the feedback loop btw training data
and production performance - especially in KYC/AML.

Would love to compare notes on labeling and eval approach. Open to a quick
chat next Wed/Thu?

subject: Building OCR Models
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw your work on OCR and entity extraction at [COMPANY] and thought Encord
might be relevant.

Working with labelling teams at Reducto, AppFolio, and UiPath, we keep
seeing the same shift: once extraction accuracy improves, the real
bottleneck becomes reliably catching failures - layout drift, OCR
ambiguity, multilingual edge cases.

Encord's platform helps teams close that loop back into training and
evaluation without heavy engineering lift. Curious how you're thinking
about it, open to a quick chat next week?

subject: Thoughts for Ironclad
text:
Hi [NAME],

Building accurate models on contract and legal data is a uniquely hard
problem - the documents are complex, the edge cases matter, and labelling
at scale is painful.

Encord is built for exactly this. Teams like Reducto & UiPath use our
platform to automate labelling for speed, build flexible structures that
handle document complexity, and run QA workflows to keep quality high.

Would you be open to connecting next week to learn more?

subject: Encord x [COMPANY] - Intro
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've heard from a few of your team that zero-shot VLM performance hasn't
held up for domain-specific driving data, and building efficient MLOps
pipelines to support fine-tuning at scale is a real challenge.

That's exactly what Encord is built for. We support 300+ AI teams including
Motive with AI dashcam annotation - managing billion-mile datasets and
automating labelling at scale.

Would love to explore how we can achieve similar results for [COMPANY],
would you be open to exploring Encord further?

subject: Smartapp <> Encord: Brena
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following what you're building with brena - the spec extraction
and auto-scheduling features are a genuinely different take on jobsite AI.

Curious how you're thinking about the data side, specifically labeling the
field documents and construction imagery that teach brena to extract and
reason correctly. That's the exact problem we help teams at Actuate, Maven
Robotics and Nimble Robotics solve at encord.

Would love to get your take and compare notes on approaches to such
challenges, do you have 20 mins on Tues/Wed?

subject: [NAME] <> Encord: Brena
text:
Hi [NAME],

Six years into scaling Smartapp, and Brena is now doing real operational
work - scheduling, spec extraction, budget generation. Coming from [SENDER]
and JMC, you know better than most how quickly field teams lose faith in
tech that misfires on a jobsite.

As Brena touches more workflows, the hardest question is knowing before
every release, that spec extraction holds up on messy redlines, that
schedules handle real dependencies, that safety flags don't drown crews in
false positives.

Encord is the data and evals layer visual and multimodal AI teams like *Boston
Dynamics, Actuate and Nimble Robotics* use to prove that. Curate the long
tail of jobsite data, grade model and agent outputs against structured
rubrics, ship features with measurable quality.

Worth 15 min to trade notes as Brena's rollout widens?

subject: Scaling Gantter ML Roadmap
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following the brena launch, a really interesting direction for
gantter.

Curious how you're thinking about evaluating whether the AI suggestions are
accurate and relevant - that's a notoriously hard problem when the outputs
are open-ended like schedule generation. We work with OnsiteIQ and
Attentive.AI on exactly that.

Would love to compare notes on challenges regarding the construction
intelligence CV.

subject: Smartapp <> Encord: Brena AI
text:
Hi [NAME],

Watched the arc of Brena from scheduling into drawing extraction and
near-live 3D twins. Impressive how fast you're pushing multimodal into the
jobsite.

Curious how your team is handling the data side as those models scale with
regards to curating BIM/CAD/360 imagery, catching edge cases, and
evaluating spec-extraction accuracy before shipping.

Actuate, Nimble Robotics and Maven Robotics use us to build training/eval
datasets for multimodal models and run structured evals on model and agent
outputs so AI features land with measurable quality.

Worth 20 mins to compare notes on your Brena roadmap?
